## Description {#details}

<p>Takes <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scev">SCEV</a> S and <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/loop">Loop</a> L.</p>


<p>For each AddRec sub-expression, use its post increment expression in case its <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/loop">Loop</a> is L. If it is not L then use AddRec itself. If <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scev">SCEV</a> contains non-invariant unknown <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scev">SCEV</a> rewrite cannot be done.</p>


<p>Definition at line 4909 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/analysis/scalarevolution-cpp">ScalarEvolution.cpp</a>.</p>
